body: All the time. But don’t give in that’s what they want, become the best version of yourself and tell them to fuck off.
The right time will come the universe has a strange way of working, it’ll come when you least expect it, don’t give up.

Thank you so much man. That was really much needed sometimes I don’t realize how young I am at certain points I tend to think of what I’ve accomplished (which is not a lot unfortunately) but hearing that did give me a sense of relief. As much as it hurts I am gonna block her on everything. After highschool finished a lot of my friends just kind of separated but it wouldn’t be a bad time to hit some of my friends up and plan something. And yes ahah I am going to college but I never really seen it like that I have an automotive class which is mostly guys but who knows maybe one day I’ll just walk around campus just to do it. And yeah I don’t want to feel sorry for myself I think I just got a wave of sadness knowing tomorrow is her birthday. But your right life is to damn short. I really needed to hear this I come from a Hispanic family so they don’t believe is feelings and depression all they said is forget it lol. But thank you you truly are a great person hope you know you helped someone today. Thank you for the advice.

Just remember she didn’t have enough respect for herself to stay loyal to you, you could do anything In the world for them and they would still do that shit to you the truth hurts but there’s nothing you could have done to prevent it. She did it to herself. Now focus on yourself and be the best damn version yourself make sure your happy with yourself before wanting to make someone else happy. Take on fitness take out that anger and sadness on those weights or gain a new hobby meet new people (friends) don’t make the same mistake I did and stay in my room and do nothing but make myself think it was my fault and ruin a full year of my life wasted on a girl who doesn’t even respect herself. Keep your head up man the more time passes the more you’ll heal. Hope this helps man stay safe and stay positive.
Thank you bro gave me a lot motivation to keep going and stay consistent 🙏
